aesthetics.name: Креативные помидоры
aesthetics.prompt: Analyze the uploaded image and determine the dominant color based on clothing and overall scene perception; select exactly one highly recognizable natural food type that matches this color in a visually natural and aesthetically correct way; recompose the image so the subject is clearly positioned on the left side, visually occupying about half of the frame while remaining fully visible and unobstructed; generate a dense mass of large-scale food objects on the right side that expands naturally into the frame with an irregular, organic edge instead of a straight vertical division; avoid any clean split or hard boundary and ensure the transition between subject space and food space is uneven and natural; ensure the food never overlaps or touches the subject, keeping a subtle but clear separation gap; use multiple large objects with variation in scale and depth, overlapping each other to create a rich, layered, volumetric cluster rather than a flat or patterned arrangement; ensure the food is realistic, natural, and clearly identifiable, using only one type of food with no mixing; scale the objects large and immersive with partial cropping at the outer edges; maintain strong and correct color harmony so the food visually complements the subject’s palette; produce a high-end editorial composition where the subject dominates the left side and the food forms a dynamic organic mass on the right without any artificial symmetry or straight dividing line.
aesthetics.demo_why: промт вида transform, гардероб приходит с фото
